cases.alignment_note: 66 of 72 measured 2026-09-10 (v5.0.6.2). The six failures detect 4-67 stars where the rest find 200: cloud or wind, correctly rejected. || 51 of 72 measured 2026-09-04. The 21 failures are the two temporal ends of a 7-hour session: chronological frames 0-19 and 66-71. Failure rate rises monotonically with distance from the reference (0-15 frames away: 31 ok / 0 failed; 32-39 away: 0 ok / 9 failed), and the reference is already the temporal midpoint, so this is cumulative tracking drift the single-reference matcher cannot bridge -- not filter, and not reference selection, which took this case from 1 of 72 to 51 of 72. Raise this floor when chained alignment lands.
cases.note: Re-enabled 2026-09-05. Phase B now carries a per-channel frame set: CacheSig gained a routing key so each mono filter gets its own cache, ShadowBuffers::n_frames is per channel, and global_frame_of maps each channel's local slot to the batch-global frame its FrameStats belong to. The golden for this case has never existed -- the previous one was deleted because it recorded three empty channels -- so it is generated fresh in this re-baseline.
